en-US.summary: Coordinate family wellness follow-ups with context and consent.
examplePhrases: I feel more tired than usual
en-US.name: CarePulse
en-US.description: CarePulse helps a family record everyday wellness signals, notice changes from an established routine, schedule follow-ups, and notify an authorized caregiver when a configured condition repeats. CarePulse does not diagnose or replace professional or emergency care.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Use the en-US model. Say: I feel more tired than usual. Accept the follow-up and scoped caregiver consent. Then say: I still feel the same. Verify the CarePulse follow-up card and the authorized SNS notification. Test summaries and preferences by saying: use detailed summaries; set my follow up time to eight PM. Enable the Alexa.Presentation.APL interface before testing the optional screen dashboard.
